WITH RECURSIVE seq AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN #{bucket}='day' THEN DATE_FORMAT(#{from}, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(#{from}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') END AS bstart UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN #{bucket}='day' THEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(bstart, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(bstart, INTERVAL 1 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') END FROM seq WHERE bstart < #{to} ) SELECT s.bstart AS bucketStart, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.event_type='TRIGGER' THEN 1 END),0) AS triggerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.event_type='CLEAR' THEN 1 END),0) AS clearCount FROM seq s LEFT JOIN alarm_item_log l ON l.created_at >= s.bstart AND l.created_at < CASE WHEN #{bucket}='day' THEN DATE_ADD(s.bstart, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE DATE_ADD(s.bstart, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) END LEFT JOIN alarm_item i ON i.global_code = l.global_code
GROUP BY s.bstart ORDER BY s.bstart

SELECT i.global_code AS globalCode, i.title_zh AS titleZh, i.title_en AS titleEn, COUNT(*) AS count, 0 AS totalDurationSeconds FROM alarm_item_log l JOIN alarm_item i ON i.global_code = l.global_code
AND l.event_type='TRIGGER' GROUP BY i.global_code, i.title_zh, i.title_en ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, i.global_code LIMIT #{limit}
